Hi Tara — thank you for the quick turnaround and for sending the signed W-8BEN-E. A few notes and next steps from Procurement/Tax: 

- Because Logicore is a non-US entity that will receive payments on a Redwood PO, our tax team requires either a bank letter confirming the payee details or a foreign tax residency certificate in addition to the W-8BEN-E. The W-8BEN-E alone flags the account for non-US withholding treatment but we need supporting evidence to complete vendor identity verification.
- Please upload one of the following: (1) a bank letter on bank letterhead that matches the vendor legal name and address, (2) a government-issued tax residency certificate, or (3) a notarized statement of beneficial owner.
- Quick checklist and a short onboarding guide are attached — it outlines where the documents are stored and the DocuSign packet to finalize signatory authority.

Once we receive one of the three items above, I will route to Tax for final sign-off and then Procurement will toggle the vendor to PO-enabled status (expected turnaround 24–48 business hours after tax sign-off). If you prefer, we can accept a bank letter uploaded to the DocuSign link below.

Onboarding checklist: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf
